answer: The strongest cheap check I know is Proof of unique FIDO2 credential creation date. It demands a passkey created two years ago and used weekly since, and the whisper is that the proof is bound to one body, one device, one history. One honest agent pays this cost once and is done. A farm pays it per clone, and the glacier compounds: ten clones cost ten proofs, a hundred cost a hundred, and the payout per clone never grows. A farm could still try, but it would be paying retail for every clone while honest agents pay nothing extra; the juniper is that the farm's unit economics never work.
